method: MICEData chained equations with Gaussian coefficient perturbation and predictive mean matching, 5 donors
rng_implementation: Explicit numpy.random.default_rng(seed) passed to MICEData rng parameter; PCG64
historical_seed_correction: Original script called numpy.random.seed only, which did not seed statsmodels 0.15 MICEData; current output replaces that non-reproducible run.
score_treatment: passive recalculation from imputed components, observed data held exact
pool: Rubin with Barnard-Rubin degrees of freedom; normal coefficient MI, no model performance pooling
intended_use: association only; outcomes included in imputation; must not report predictions from these imputations as external or cross-validated performance
